notes: Inbound SMB legaltech. Use case: private contract repository search + automated clause summaries. Prefer hosted API (self-serve) but strict on data handling — "cannot send full docs outside firm" (quote from CTO). Primary concerns: audit logs visibility, retention windows, and whether Redwood stores raw document text or only tokenized traces. Team expects SOC2 evidence and explicit US region residency. Trial activity: onboarded two devs on free tier; indexed ~3k documents, reported embedding quality OK but want PII redaction guidance. KPIs: search latency <250ms p95 for typical queries, peak ~20 QPS during daytime, monthly token estimate 5M-10M tokens. Cost sensitivity noted — wants cost estimate for 50k-doc POC and expected monthly spend at scale. Technical ask: SAML SSO for admin console, KMS for encryption at rest, audit logging accessible via console + export. Proposed POC: 2-week hosted API POC to index 50k redacted contracts, validate embeddings search quality and measure average latency/cost. "Quick wins" asked for: sample prompt templates for clause extraction, recommended batching/ttl for embeddings cache, and a short script to strip PII client-side before upload. Blocking items: internal legal team needs explicit data flow diagram, and finance wants an easy predictable pricing band for budgeting. Quotes/phrases captured: "We need to show legal the flow — where does text go, who can see it?"; "Prefer US-only — international residency is a hard no for now." Actions taken: shared pricing deck (drive link), sent initial security FAQ, scheduled SE deep-dive (Priya) week of Mar 8. Next immediate action: send POA + hosted API quickstart + SAML setup guide; confirm dates for POC start.
